active: Wayfarer. Crownsfall stands, but barely. The Whisperwood east of the gate has turned — things walk there that remember nothing but hunger.
The Archive's last pages were carried into that wood when the old wardens fell. Without them, the city forgets itself. Will you bring them back?

ready.objective: Return the pages to Captain Ralden

ready: Three pages, whole and unburnt. You have done what a company of my soldiers could not.
But these pages name something else — a warden of the wood who did not fall. The Thornwarden still stands in the meadow at the wood's heart. End it, and the Whisperwood is ours again.
active: The pages are held by the wood's guardians: in the Flower Dell to the south-west, at the Fae Ring to the south, and among the Standing Stones in the north-east. Check your map (M).

active.objective: Slay the Thornwarden in the Mossy Meadow

active: The Thornwarden waits in the Mossy Meadow, at the end of the trail south of the glade. Rest, mend your gear, then go.
ready: It is done, then. The Whisperwood is quiet for the first time in a generation.
Hollowmere lies beyond it — and whatever drowned it. When you are ready, Crownsfall will need you again.

epilogue.title: THE WHISPERWOOD IS FREE
lines: The Thornwarden has fallen and the old wood breathes again.
But the pages speak of the marsh beyond: the wardens' lanterns in Hollowmere have gone dark, and something below the water is waking.
Chapter II begins: cross the mossy arch in the Whisperwood's south-east into Hollowmere.

active.objective: Cross the Mossy Arch into Hollowmere

active: The Thornwarden was only a gatekeeper. Beyond the mossy arch in the Whisperwood's south-east lies Hollowmere, where the wardens once kept their lanterns burning against the dark water.
The lanterns are out. Whatever drowned the wardens is rising. Go through the arch and see what is left.

ready.objective: Bring the flames to Captain Ralden

active: Each lantern held a warden's flame. Whatever guards them now took them when the lanterns died: the Reed-Mother in the north, the Willow Hag in the south, the Bonekeeper on the isle of bones.
Take the flames back. The Ferryman's Rest waypoint will bring you home and back again.
ready: Three flames, still burning. The wardens kept these alive for three hundred years.
They burn toward the east, toward the Sunken Chapel. Something there drowned the wardens, and it is still down there. End it.

active.objective: Destroy the Drowned Matron in the Sunken Chapel

epilogue.title: THE MERE IS STILL
lines: The Drowned Matron sinks for the last time and the wardens' lanterns burn again across Hollowmere.
Crownsfall's road east is open. More of the lost realm waits beyond the marsh in chapters to come.
You may keep exploring, hunting and gathering gear.

active: The Sunken Chapel lies at the far east of the mere, where the boardwalk ends. Mend your gear, then go.
ready: The mere is quiet? Then the wardens can rest at last.
Crownsfall owes you twice over, Wayfarer. Take this — you have earned it.
